description: Houston, TX–Today, Congresswoman Lizzie Fletcher (TX-07) released the following statement after a three-judge panel in El Paso considering the case of LULAC v. Abbott issued a preliminary injunction prohibiting the use of the congressional map the Texas Legislature passed and Governor Greg Abbott signed into law in 2025 in the 2026 elections.

title: Congresswoman Lizzie Fletcher Statement on Court Ruling Enjoining New Texas Congressional Map – Lizzie Pannill Fletcher | U.S. Congress | Texas 7th Congressional District
